Contract CoCoMESystem::closeCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.Id = cashDeskID and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		self.CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentCashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk@pre and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.Id = cashDeskID and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened@pre = true and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = false and
		self.CurrentStore = self.CurrentStore@pre and
		self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true and
		result = true
}
